name: prompto
description: Keep your prompts tidy, searchable, and ready to use — all from a clean file-based workflow in AI Code Editors.

commands.title: Prompto: 复制选中内容（解析路径模板）

prompto.desktop.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable named Copilot sessions, Qoder CN tasks and Lingxi project-task delivery on local Windows. Copilot uses agent-desktop; Qoder and Lingxi require dedicated loopback CDP shortcuts and verified executable identity. Qoder replaces target drafts with per-line exact readback, preserving blank lines without changing the clipboard. A single send requires an independent new user-message receipt. A user-level false disables all three targets. No automatic retry or transport fallback.

prompto.desktop.executablePath.markdownDescription: Optional absolute path to the native agent-desktop `.exe` for named Copilot sessions only, not the npm `.cmd` or `.ps1` shim. Qoder and Lingxi use CDP instead. Empty searches PATH and global npm installation directories.

prompto.qoder.cdpPort.markdownDescription: Qoder CN CDP port from its dedicated shortcut. Only 127.0.0.1 is accepted after verifying the owning executable. User-level setting only; Prompto does not start or close Qoder.

prompto.qoder.executablePath.markdownDescription: Optional absolute Qoder CN .exe path for port-owner verification, not the launcher. Empty recognizes the running port owner's Qoder CN.exe directly inside any version directory under LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/Qoder CN/.qoder-versions, without pinning a version. The process and exact executable path remain bound throughout each delivery. A non-empty setting strictly pins the supplied path; clear an old value after upgrading to restore automatic detection. Check the CDP shortcut target after upgrading.

prompto.lingxi.cdpPort.markdownDescription: Lingxi CDP port from the dedicated shortcut. Only 127.0.0.1 is accepted after verifying the owning executable. Prompto does not start or close Lingxi.

prompto.lingxi.executablePath.markdownDescription: Optional absolute Lingxi .exe path for port-owner verification. Empty uses LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/lingxi-desktop/WPS 灵犀.exe.

enumDescriptions: Fill the selected prompt into the configured chat target without sending it.
Send the selected prompt immediately to the configured chat target.
Copy the selected prompt to the clipboard.
prompto.outputMode.markdownDescription: Controls what happens after selecting a prompt with **Prompto: Use Prompt**. Prompt metadata can override this with `outputMode`.

enumDescriptions: Deliver prompts to GitHub Copilot Chat.
Deliver through dedicated local CDP to an existing Qoder CN task selected by document chatSession.workspace and title. Exact multiline draft readback; no agent-desktop or clipboard fallback.

Deliver to an existing Lingxi task selected by document chatSession.project and title. Dedicated local CDP shortcut required; users judge idle without a confirmation dialog. Replaces target drafts by default, supports prefill and single-send receipt verification, never retries.
Deliver prompts to the active terminal, intended for Claude Code.
prompto.deliveryTarget.markdownDescription: Selects which chat surface receives prompts when **Prompto: Use Prompt** runs. Prompt metadata can override this with `deliveryTarget`.

prompto.promptsDirectory.markdownDescription: Workspace-relative folder that stores Prompto markdown prompt files.
